stories.title: Saudi Arabia condemns terrorist attack on security checkpoint in Pakistan

en.title: Saudi Arabia condemns terrorist attack on security checkpoint in Pakistan
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's Ministry of Foreign Affairs issued a statement strongly condemning a terrorist attack on a security checkpoint in Pakistan's Dera Ismail Khan region that resulted in multiple fatalities. The Kingdom expressed solidarity with Pakistan and reaffirmed its opposition to all forms of terrorism and extremism.

stories.title: ‎INEOS halts Europe’s last 3 major acetyls plants as gas prices soar

en.title: INEOS halts Europe's last 3 major acetyls plants as gas prices soar
en.summary: INEOS suspended operations at three chemical plants in Britain after European gas prices rose to approximately 12 times higher than U.S. levels, making the facilities economically unviable. These are Europe's last remaining large-scale industrial acetyls production units.

stories.title: ‎Industry Ministry issues 364 licenses worth SAR 4.5B in June

en.title: Industry Ministry issues 364 licenses worth SAR 4.5B in June
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's Ministry of Industry and Mineral Resources issued 364 new industrial licenses in June worth approximately SAR 4.46 billion, with 164 factories beginning production. The projects are expected to generate over 3,138 job opportunities across the Kingdom.

en.title: Tadawul announces Q3 2026 index maintenance
en.summary: The Saudi Exchange announced updates to free-float shares for listed companies effective October 4. Several companies including Chemanol, Armah Sports, Ladun Investment, and Amwaj International were added to various indices on the Main Market and Nomu-Parallel Market.
